name: Wes Empire Custom Login Page Customizer & Stealth Portal
author: wesempire

sections.description:
Wes Empire Custom Login Page Customizer & Stealth Portal replaces the generic WordPress login screen (wp-login.php) with a clean, dual-view sign-in and password recovery portal embedded directly into any custom WordPress page via shortcode.

Unlike basic “hide login” plugins that merely change the URL slug while leaving the default WordPress logo and layout intact, this plugin gives agencies and site owners a complete, self-contained white-label portal experience:

  • Dual-View Portal Interface: Switch smoothly between the Sign-In view and Password Recovery view on the same page without jarring page reloads.
  • Custom Page Slug Integration: Place the [wesemcul_admin_login] shortcode on any page (e.g., /admin/, /login/, or /portal/) and configure the target slug in Settings.
  • Full Brand Palette Controls: Customize primary brand color, accent highlight border, header title color, subheading color, and form text color using native WordPress color pickers.
  • Search Engine Stealth: Automatically sends X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, noarchive headers and meta tags on your portal page so administrative login URLs stay out of search engine indexes.
  • Safe Core Action Whitelisting: Preserves native WordPress password reset links (rp, resetpass) and logout flows so users are never locked out.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wes-empire-custom-login-page-customizer-stealth-portal folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Wes Empire Login Customizer to set your portal name, custom page slug, and brand colors.
  4. Create a new page matching your configured slug (for example, admin) and insert the shortcode [wesemcul_admin_login].
sections.faq:
Will I get locked out when resetting my password or logging out?

No. Core actions such as logout, rp, resetpass, and postpass are explicitly whitelisted so password reset emails and logout flows complete smoothly.

Can I use any page slug for my login portal?

Yes. Set your desired slug in Settings > Wes Empire Login Customizer, create a matching WordPress page, and place [wesemcul_admin_login] inside it.
